title: UFO Investigator Stumped By Gillette Woman’s Video Of Rotating Lights In Night Sky
description: A Rock Springs UFO investigator says he has "no explanation" for video of mysterious rotating lights a Gillette woman captured. “They're everywhere,” she says about seeing them multiple times in Wyoming and Montana.

title: Lockheed Martin Reveals Mk21A ICBM Reentry Vehicle That Looks Straight Out Of UFO Files
description: Not covert anymore? Lockheed Martin unveiled its latest Intercontinental Ballistic Missile System Reentry Vehicle, dubbed Mk21A, for the US Air Force. The internet demands it release Tic Tacs too.

title: Mysterious 'UFO' spotted in NASA video sparks claim space station narrowly escaped collision
description: A strange object has been spotted in a NASA video, leading to claims that astronauts on the International Space Station were nearly involved in a fatal collision.
